findings.message:
[P2] Keep the local Deno development path usable

The new exported handler returns 426 for every request that is not HTTPS, so the documented `deno task dev` flow on `http://localhost:8000` now serves no pages or APIs. Direct Deno requests do not carry `X-Forwarded-Proto: https`, so the production-only plaintext guard needs a local development path or matching TLS/opt-out documentation and task update.

main.ts:4-6

summary: The production-facing fix binds Deno to loopback and rejects plaintext before the auth handler, but the unconditional exported-handler check also breaks the documented local Deno development path.

evidence: main.ts:22 binds `Deno.serve` to `127.0.0.1`, removing the default all-interface listener used by the public plaintext port.
main.ts:4-14 rejects non-HTTPS requests with 426 before calling `passportHandler`, so credentials and sessions are not handled on accidental plaintext requests.
src/request_origin.ts:20-24 preserves HTTPS for direct TLS and for TLS terminated by the local reverse proxy through `X-Forwarded-Proto`.
